summary.oneLiner: Engineering-led auto-component group supplying integrated switching, lighting, seating, alloy wheel, casting, sensor, controller and acoustic systems to automotive OEMs, positioned to be inside every vehicle regardless of what technology powers it.
summary.business: Uno Minda Limited manufactures auto components across eight product lines - Switch, Lighting, Seating, Alloy Wheel, Casting, Sensor, Controller and Acoustic - which together account for 91.58% of turnover. It serves automotive OEMs across vehicle segments, a domestic distributor/wholesaler network for the aftermarket and replacement market, and export customers reached via direct exports (notably from the Powertrain Solutions Division), Indian merchant exporters, and Bill-to-Ship-to arrangements.

currentContext.strengths: Technology ownership across the industry's PACE megatrends (Personalisation, Autonomous, Connected, Electric), positioning the company to remain 'inside' vehicles regardless of the powertrain technology that wins out.|R&D intensity of ~4% of revenue supporting an IP portfolio of 1,176 IPRs filed and 869 IPRs granted; recognised with the Best Patent Portfolio Award (Large Manufacturing/Engineering) and ranked among Top 30 IP-Driven Organisations at the 11th CII Industrial IP Awards 2025.|In-house design capability (INITIA design studio) recognised as 'Best In-House Design Studio' at India's Best Design Awards 2025 and winner at CII Design Excellence Awards 2025, supporting differentiated, technology-integrated product design (e.g., TD225 Tech Demonstrator, Red Dot Design Award).|Long-standing relationships with major automotive OEMs across vehicle segments, combined with a distribution network of distributors/wholesalers giving wider market penetration in the aftermarket and replacement markets.|Governance track record: recognised as 'Best Governed Company' (Listed Segment - Medium Category) at the ICSI Indian National Award for Excellence in Corporate Governance.
currentContext.strategies: Maintains a product portfolio compatible with both internal combustion (IC) engines and electric vehicles (EVs) - switches, lighting, acoustics, horns, infotainment, speakers, alloy wheels and casting - and is expanding its product range and integrating modular solutions to align with shifting consumer demand.|Investing substantially in research and development, with dedicated R&D centres in India and internationally, to develop proprietary technologies and maintain leadership in emerging markets.|Pursues strategic partnerships, including Technology Licence Agreements and Joint Ventures, to develop and deploy next-generation products and systems.|Evaluates strategic sourcing across diverse suppliers and regions with an emphasis on increasing localisation, to diversify its supply chain and mitigate geopolitical risk.|Aligns production capacity with customer demand and market conditions, expanding facilities only when there is clear evidence of increased demand or new opportunities, rather than pre-building capacity.|Emphasises close collaboration with key customers during the product development phase to keep offerings aligned with shifting market demand and to strengthen customer relationships.|For FY 2025-26, the Board declared a final dividend of Rs 1.75 per equity share (87.5%) in addition to an interim dividend of Rs 0.90 per equity share (45%, already paid), indicating a continued shareholder-return orientation alongside the Company's ongoing capacity-expansion investment programme. S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP was proposed for re-appointment as Statutory Auditors for a second five-year term, reflecting continuity in the Company's audit and governance framework.
currentContext.expansion: Uno Minda's FY 2025-26 expansion programme spanned nearly all product divisions. In Switches, component/sub-part manufacturing commenced at a new greenfield plant in Farrukhnagar, with Phase II (shifting existing Manesar and Nawada Fatehpur operations into the Farrukhnagar site to create one large integrated facility) planned for H2 FY 2026-27. In Lighting, the greenfield four-wheeler plant at Khed City, Pune ramped up production, a new four-wheeler lighting plant in Indonesia (under PT Minda Asean) commenced commercial production, and the Sonipat and Bahadurgarh two-wheeler lighting plants began consolidation into a new, larger facility at Kharkhoda, Haryana. In Castings, the company commissioned Phase 1 of a greenfield four-wheeler alloy wheel plant at Kharkhoda, announced a greenfield aluminium die-casting facility at Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (CSN) to backward-integrate casting supply for the forthcoming 4W-EV powertrain plant at Khed City, expanded two-wheeler alloy wheel capacity with a new Bawal facility, and increased aluminium die-casting capacity at Hosur. Green Mobility (EV Systems, Auto Innovation PV EV powertrains, EV-specific Controller business, and Uno Minda Westport alternate-fuel/CNG) was carved out as a distinct reporting segment; within it, a second passenger-vehicle EV powertrain plant (for Electric Drive Units and Dedicated Hybrid Transmissions) was announced at CSN, backed by an anchor customer. The company also completed the acquisition of FRIWO's stake in Uno Minda EV Systems and acquired the remaining stake in Uno Minda Buhler Motor Private Limited (UMBM), making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. A structured 'Smart Factory' transformation programme with AI-driven pilots (machine vision quality inspection, predictive maintenance, AI-enabled scheduling, real-time energy optimisation) began across three plants, with plans to scale across the manufacturing network over the next three years. For FY27, management has guided to total capex of approximately Rs 1,750 crore, split between sustaining capex (~Rs 650 crore) and growth capex (~Rs 1,100 crore, including ~Rs 250 crore for land), directed mainly at the ongoing 4W alloy wheel projects (CSN and Kharkhoda), the 2W alloy wheel project at Bawal, and the EV powertrain projects at Khed City and CSN.
currentContext.mdna: India's structural shift toward higher-value vehicles, particularly in the SUV and premium two-wheeler segments, is described as aligning perfectly with Uno Minda's product portfolio.|Domestic demand for auto components (OEM sales and aftermarket) is expected to outpace growth in India's overall automotive market by 1.4 to 1.6 times.|The Company's FY 2025-26 growth was broad-based and high-quality, driven by value-added features and volume expansion across core product offerings including Switches, Lighting, Sensors, ADAS, Seating, and its rapidly scaling EV Systems.|EV-linked components accounted for 4.6% of total OEM supplies in H1 FY 2025-26 industry-wide, reflecting accelerating penetration of high-voltage systems, battery management systems (BMS) and e-drive units into the mainstream supply chain.|The auto component sector is described as exceptionally well-positioned to benefit from supply chain diversification by global OEMs (the 'China Plus One' shift) and the expanding EV component opportunity.|Growing adoption of EVs and battery technologies is redefining vehicle architecture, with enhanced allocations for Li-ion batteries, e-drives and advanced transmission systems across OEM platforms.|Premiumisation and the shift to Software-Defined Vehicles is intensifying adoption of advanced electronics and zonal E/E architectures across vehicle categories.|Aftermarket expansion is being driven by an expanding vehicle parc and increasing average vehicle age, supported by digital sales channels and direct-to-consumer models.

risks.note: Escalation of US tariff measures since early 2025 has introduced uncertainty into global supply chains, particularly for export-oriented component manufacturers with US OEM exposure (rated Medium impact by the Company).

The rapid pace of electrification and software integration in vehicles creates a risk of portfolio obsolescence for manufacturers who do not invest ahead of the curve (rated Medium to High impact); the Company cites that over 95% of its products are platform-agnostic across ICE, hybrid and BEV as mitigation.
Dependence on a limited set of OEM customers in specific vehicle segments could affect revenues during periods of demand softness or model-level changes (rated Medium impact).
Fluctuations in key raw material prices, particularly aluminium, copper and electronic components, can compress margins and affect cost structure (rated Medium impact).
Growing international revenues and import of technology components create exposure to adverse currency movements affecting reported earnings (rated Low to Medium impact).

Evolving emission norms, EV safety regulations and compliance requirements across operating geographies may require investments in product redesign and regulatory infrastructure (rated Medium impact).
The rapid evolution of automotive technologies requires specialised skills in EV systems, ADAS and software-defined vehicles that are in short supply globally (rated Medium impact).

The Company operated in a year marked by increasing cybersecurity threats across its Information Technology and Operational Technology environments; management has reinforced its cybersecurity posture through a governance framework aligned with global security and privacy standards, given the Company's extensive global footprint and digitised operations.

one-line thesis: Uno Minda delivered record Q4 and FY26 revenues and profits driven by broad-based volume growth and EV/CNG adoption, but faces near-term margin pressure from commodity and labor inflation; the company is aggressively scaling EV powertrain and sunroof capabilities with INR 1,750cr FY27 capex, positioning for structural growth despite temporary execution risks.
financial scorecard: revenue: +18% YoY (INR 5,336cr Q4); EBITDA/margin: +14% YoY to INR 603cr, 11.3% margin (one-off: Q4 debit/credit adjustments, aluminum pass-through lag); PAT (rptd): +22% YoY to INR 326cr; PAT (normalized): INR 1,166cr FY26 (+24% YoY); order book: INR 450cr (2W lighting); INR 390cr (seating exports); INR 85cr (sunroof); INR 600cr (IVI); INR 200cr (2W silver box); net debt: INR 2,179cr as of Mar'26 (+4% YoY, driven by UMEVSPL acquisition and capex)
guidance: revenue growth: +17% FY26, FY27 guidance not explicitly stated but implied to be strong; margin: 11% ±50bps; order inflow: multiple multi-crore wins secured (e.g., INR 450cr 2W lighting SOP H2 FY28); capex/commissioning: FY27 capex INR 1,750cr (INR 1,100cr growth), 7/11 projects ramping in FY27, EV powertrain plants (Khed & CSN) commissioning H2 FY27 and Q2 FY28, sunroof plant commissioning end FY27
order book & pipeline: INR 450cr (2-wheeler lighting, SOP H2 FY28); INR 390cr (seating exports to Europe/N. America, SOP FY28); INR 85cr (sunroof, total book >INR 350cr); INR 600cr (IVI platform, SOP Q3 FY29); INR 200cr (2-wheeler silver box display, SOP Q4 FY27)
segment / subsidiary detail: Switches: INR 1,343cr Q4 (+17% YoY), 2W switch exports INR 280cr FY26; Lighting: INR 1,154cr Q4 (+13% YoY), new INR 450cr 2W lighting order; Casting: INR 982cr Q4 (+14% YoY), aluminum pass-through ~4-5%, 4W alloy wheel penetration ~40%, 2W ~70%; Seating: INR 381cr Q4 (+23% FY26), new INR 390cr export orders; Green Mobility: INR 423cr Q4 (+25% YoY), FY26 total INR 1,405cr (CNG: INR 592cr, 2W/3W EV: INR 501cr); Others: INR 1,053cr Q4 (+25% YoY), IVI and sunroof key drivers
growth verticals / optionality: EV powertrain (EDU/DHT) via UMAIPL (Khed & CSN plants); sunroof manufacturing (commissioning end FY27); in-house Android IVI platform (INR 600cr order); 2W silver box display (INR 200cr order); CNG system expansion with 22% PV penetration; export diversification into Europe/N. America
margins & cost dynamics: Q4 EBITDA margin 11.3% held despite aluminum price inflation (~4-5% pass-through impact), labor cost hikes (35% in Haryana/Gujarat), and commodity volatility; margin guidance of 11%±50bps for FY27 assumes partial price pass-through and operational efficiencies; near-term margin pressure expected from lagged input cost pass-through and startup costs in new plants
capex / expansion: FY26: INR 1,572cr (INR 861cr growth, INR 149cr land, INR 200cr UMEVSPL acquisition); FY27: INR 1,750cr (INR 1,100cr growth, INR 650cr sustaining, land acquisition pending); major capex: INR 550cr for CSN EV powertrain plant (2nd), Khed EV plant (H2 FY27), sunroof facility (end FY27), alloy wheel expansions
capital allocation: Dividend: INR 2.65/share FY26 (total INR 153cr); capex funded via internal accruals + incremental debt; net debt-to-equity improved to 0.30; ROCE 19.2%, ROE 19.1%; strategic acquisitions (UMEVSPL) and land bank prioritized for long-term capacity
risks & watch-items: Commodity price volatility (aluminum, energy); labor cost inflation (35% hikes in key states); delayed price pass-through from OEMs; execution risk across 7+ new plant ramp-ups in FY27; EV demand slowdown; currency fluctuations on export exposure
management quality / tone: Confident and aggressive; emphasized execution discipline, strategic capex, and long-term EV/CNG leadership; acknowledged near-term margin headwinds but expressed strong customer collaboration on cost pass-through; tone was bullish on India’s auto growth and Uno Minda’s diversification trajectory
non-obvious takeaways: Labor cost inflation (35% in Haryana/Gujarat) is a systemic, underappreciated margin threat beyond commodities; the INR 600cr IVI order represents a 70% revenue uplift from current JV revenues, signaling a major tech leap; 35% of 3-wheeler production is now exported — a hidden export engine; ESG initiatives (differently-abled hiring, CSR centers) are operationalized at scale, not just PR

themes.title: Auto components & EV-driveline localization
themes.need: Premiumization, content-per-vehicle rise and EV/hybrid transition pull a deep auto-ancillary chain - MOTHERSON/SONACOMS/BOSCHLTD/SCHAEFFLER/SKFINDIA/UNOMINDA-tier on driveline, bearings, wiring (MSUMI) and EV systems; OLAELEC/ATHERENERG/OLECTRA on EV OEMs (OLAELEC targeting cell-to-pack 10-15% cost edge); SUNDRMFAST/ENDURANCE/CRAFTSMAN/BHARATFORG on forgings/machining. Q1FY27 showed contracted pricing finally landing for Tier-2s: SSWL earned EBITDA/wheel of Rs 314 against Rs 262 YoY, which management attributed mostly to two years of OEM input-price increases finally landing (1-5%, more pending) rather than mix, with all plants above 95% utilisation and knuckles at 100%; KROSS delivered a 12.23% EBITDA margin (+63bps) BEFORE two retrospective pass-throughs land (steel settled ~15 July, the CV conversion-cost settlement still pending), making Q1 a floor rather than a peak.
themes.driver: GST 2.0 demand pull; retrospective OEM price pass-throughs still to land (KROSS CV conversion cost); EV cell/Gigafactory ramps (OLAELEC 6GWh by June); export + new-platform content wins.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- India's structural shift toward higher-value vehicles, particularly in the SUV and premium two-wheeler segments, is described as aligning perfectly with Uno Minda's product portfolio.
- Domestic demand for auto components (OEM sales and aftermarket) is expected to outpace growth in India's overall automotive market by 1.4 to 1.6 times.
- The Company's FY 2025-26 growth was broad-based and high-quality, driven by value-added features and volume expansion across core product offerings including Switches, Lighting, Sensors, ADAS, Seating, and its rapidly scaling EV Systems.
- EV-linked components accounted for 4.6% of total OEM supplies in H1 FY 2025-26 industry-wide, reflecting accelerating penetration of high-voltage systems, battery management systems (BMS) and e-drive units into the mainstream supply chain.
- The auto component sector is described as exceptionally well-positioned to benefit from supply chain diversification by global OEMs (the 'China Plus One' shift) and the expanding EV component opportunity.
- Growing adoption of EVs and battery technologies is redefining vehicle architecture, with enhanced allocations for Li-ion batteries, e-drives and advanced transmission systems across OEM platforms.
- Premiumisation and the shift to Software-Defined Vehicles is intensifying adoption of advanced electronics and zonal E/E architectures across vehicle categories.
- Aftermarket expansion is being driven by an expanding vehicle parc and increasing average vehicle age, supported by digital sales channels and direct-to-consumer models.

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: Q4 EBITDA margin 11.3% held despite aluminum price inflation (~4-5% pass-through impact), labor cost hikes (35% in Haryana/Gujarat), and commodity volatility; margin guidance of 11%±50bps for FY27 assumes partial price pass-through and operational efficiencies; near-term margin pressure expected from lagged input cost pass-through and startup costs in new plants

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: Dividend: INR 2.65/share FY26 (total INR 153cr); capex funded via internal accruals + incremental debt; net debt-to-equity improved to 0.30; ROCE 19.2%, ROE 19.1%; strategic acquisitions (UMEVSPL) and land bank prioritized for long-term capacity

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Uno Minda's FY 2025-26 expansion programme spanned nearly all product divisions. In Switches, component/sub-part manufacturing commenced at a new greenfield plant in Farrukhnagar, with Phase II (shifting existing Manesar and Nawada Fatehpur operations into the Farrukhnagar site to create one large integrated facility) planned for H2 FY 2026-27. In Lighting, the greenfield four-wheeler plant at Khed City, Pune ramped up production, a new four-wheeler lighting plant in Indonesia (under PT Minda Asean) commenced commercial production, and the Sonipat and Bahadurgarh two-wheeler lighting plants began consolidation into a new, larger facility at Kharkhoda, Haryana. In Castings, the company commissioned Phase 1 of a greenfield four-wheeler alloy wheel plant at Kharkhoda, announced a greenfield aluminium die-casting facility at Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (CSN) to backward-integrate casting supply for the forthcoming 4W-EV powertrain plant at Khed City, expanded two-wheeler alloy wheel capacity with a new Bawal facility, and increased aluminium die-casting capacity at Hosur. Green Mobility (EV Systems, Auto Innovation PV EV powertrains, EV-specific Controller business, and Uno Minda Westport alternate-fuel/CNG) was carved out as a distinct reporting segment; within it, a second passenger-vehicle EV powertrain plant (for Electric Drive Units and Dedicated Hybrid Transmissions) was announced at CSN, backed by an anchor customer. The company also completed the acquisition of FRIWO's stake in Uno Minda EV Systems and acquired the remaining stake in Uno Minda Buhler Motor Private Limited (UMBM), making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. A structured 'Smart Factory' transformation programme with AI-driven pilots (machine vision quality inspection, predictive maintenance, AI-enabled scheduling, real-time energy optimisation) began across three plants, with plans to scale across the manufacturing network over the next three years. For FY27, management has guided to total capex of approximately Rs 1,750 crore, split between sustaining capex (~Rs 650 crore) and growth capex (~Rs 1,100 crore, including ~Rs 250 crore for land), directed mainly at the ongoing 4W alloy wheel projects (CSN and Kharkhoda), the 2W alloy wheel project at Bawal, and the EV powertrain projects at Khed City and CSN.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident and aggressive; emphasized execution discipline, strategic capex, and long-term EV/CNG leadership; acknowledged near-term margin headwinds but expressed strong customer collaboration on cost pass-through; tone was bullish on India’s auto growth and Uno Minda’s diversification trajectory

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Technology ownership across the industry's PACE megatrends (Personalisation, Autonomous, Connected, Electric), positioning the company to remain 'inside' vehicles regardless of the powertrain technology that wins out.
- R&D intensity of ~4% of revenue supporting an IP portfolio of 1,176 IPRs filed and 869 IPRs granted; recognised with the Best Patent Portfolio Award (Large Manufacturing/Engineering) and ranked among Top 30 IP-Driven Organisations at the 11th CII Industrial IP Awards 2025.
- In-house design capability (INITIA design studio) recognised as 'Best In-House Design Studio' at India's Best Design Awards 2025 and winner at CII Design Excellence Awards 2025, supporting differentiated, technology-integrated product design (e.g., TD225 Tech Demonstrator, Red Dot Design Award).
- Long-standing relationships with major automotive OEMs across vehicle segments, combined with a distribution network of distributors/wholesalers giving wider market penetration in the aftermarket and replacement markets.
- Governance track record: recognised as 'Best Governed Company' (Listed Segment - Medium Category) at the ICSI Indian National Award for Excellence in Corporate Governance.

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Commodity price volatility (aluminum, energy); labor cost inflation (35% hikes in key states); delayed price pass-through from OEMs; execution risk across 7+ new plant ramp-ups in FY27; EV demand slowdown; currency fluctuations on export exposure

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: Labor cost inflation (35% in Haryana/Gujarat) is a systemic, underappreciated margin threat beyond commodities; the INR 600cr IVI order represents a 70% revenue uplift from current JV revenues, signaling a major tech leap; 35% of 3-wheeler production is now exported — a hidden export engine; ESG initiatives (differently-abled hiring, CSR centers) are operationalized at scale, not just PR
